review_note: Kani harness must use kani::any() for arbitrary header bytes, not hardcoded values. Current kani_record_payload_len.rs uses hardcoded magic 0x5650424C — new harness kani_budget_payload_too_large needs kani::any() for ALL header fields. Rationale: proving PayloadTooLarge before allocation on ARBITRARY hostile input requires arbitrary bytes, not one fixed test vector.

kani_codec.rs has kani_truncated_header_* harnesses but uses fixed magic 0x5642_4A45. New harness kani_header_total_function needs kani::any() for magic and max to prove totality on ALL inputs, not just VBJE magic. The proof target is decode_record_header is total on &[u8], covering all magic values.

Payload slice bounds proof requires showing bytes.get(60..60+payload_len) returns Some only when payload_len <= max. This is already partially covered by kani_record_payload_len.rs but that harness doesn't test the payload slicing path in decode_record_payload — it only tests the header budget check. New harness needed in kani_budget_payload.rs.

Overflow check proof requires payload_len u32 that causes 60 + payload_len to overflow usize. This is a narrow edge case (payload_len > usize::MAX - 60). Kani harness should generate arbitrary u32 and constrain to overflow range. This is distinct from payload_len > max (budget check) — this is about usize overflow in the slice computation.

Magic ordering proof requires showing BadMagic returned before HeaderChecksumMismatch, PayloadTooLarge, etc. kani_codec.rs kani_wrong_magic_any_value() proves BadMagic but doesn't prove ordering vs other errors. Need new harness that generates header bytes passing magic check but failing other checks to prove BadMagic is checked FIRST.

Unknown kind proof requires arbitrary u16 for record_kind excluding known variants. kani::any::<u16>() with assume() to exclude known variants. This is straightforward but must be separate from magic ordering proof.

BUDGET GATE LINE 48 is the primary proof target. Must show Err(PayloadTooLarge) is reached at line 48 BEFORE any branch that could allocate. Current code has no allocation before line 48, but Kani harness should verify this ordering. Header bytes must be constructed to pass magic/schema/kind/family checks but fail budget check.

Header length proof is straightforward. kani::any::<u32>() for header_len excluding 60. Note: this overlaps with vb-3t44 scope (kani_codec.rs) but vb-8mdp.2 focuses on budget-before-decode context. Should be included for completeness of the decode path coverage.

Schema version proof: kani::any::<u16>() for schema_version with explicit branches for >1, <1, ==1. kani_codec.rs kani_future_schema_version and kani_past_schema_version exist but use fixed test vectors. New harness uses kani::any() for exhaustiveness.

CRC mismatch proof: arbitrary header_checksum via kani::any() guaranteed not to match computed CRC. kani_codec.rs kani_bad_crc() exists but with fixed test case. New harness with kani::any() is needed for exhaustiveness.
DIGEST PROOF ALREADY EXISTS in vb-3t44 scope (kani_digest_checks_vb_2bzz.rs). Marking as not_applicable to avoid duplication. vb-8mdp.2 does not need to re-prove digest verification.

decode_optional proof requires tracing through: keyspace.get(key) returns borrowed &[u8] -> decode_record called on that slice -> budget gate runs. Kani must prove no Vec creation in this path. Existing kani_recovery_hydrate.rs has partial coverage but needs update to prove no allocation before budget gate.

Journal event semantic validity: kani::any::<JournalEvent>() that deserializes but fails is_valid(). Need to construct arbitrary JournalEvent bytes via kani::any() that pass postcard but fail run_id=0, seq=u64::MAX, or attempt=0. This is a challenging harness to write correctly.

Snapshot budget proof: FjallJournal::snapshot calls decode_optional with MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES. Kani harness needs arbitrary snapshot bytes with arbitrary payload_len and must prove budget check runs before postcard. kani_recovery_hydrate.rs has some coverage but needs update.
Blob budget proof: similar to snapshot budget but for blob read path. Kani harness with arbitrary blob bytes proves MAX_BLOB_BYTES budget enforced. kani_recovery_hydrate.rs has some coverage.

Verus totality proof: spec fn for decode_record_header with explicit slice bounds checking. Proves get(..60) returns None -> UnexpectedEof for short input. This is a formal proof that complements Kani's bounded model checking.

Verus payload_len invariant: ensures_with postcondition payload_len <= max_payload_len. Formal proof of the budget invariant at the type level. This complements Kani's operational proof with a declarative specification.
TLA+ keyspace prefix distinctness: 9 prefixes must be pairwise distinct. Model check with TLC. This is a straightforward invariant proof in TLA+.
TLA+ budget-before-decode workflow invariant: if payload_len > max then error = PayloadTooLarge and payload not accessed. Model check with TLC. This proves the invariant at the system/workflow level.
Fuzz target proof: cargo kani --fuzz replaces fuzzer input with kani::any() for exhaustiveness. Need to verify the fuzz target harness structure is compatible with Kani's --fuzz mode.

Miri NOT APPLICABLE for budget-before-decode proof: Miri detects UB but cannot prove absence of pre-budget allocation because the allocation itself is not UB. The issue is a logic error (allocation before budget check), not UB. Kani is the correct tool for this proof. Evidence: Miri runs exist on vb_storage codec tests confirming no UB in current code.

Flux NOT APPLICABLE: Flux RS requires nightly-only setup with specific feature flags. vb_storage does not enable fluxRs feature. Verus provides equivalent payload_len invariant proof on stable-compatible setup. No need for nightly-only tools here.

Loom NOT APPLICABLE: decode_optional is single-threaded. No concurrent access patterns exist in the budget-before-decode read path. Concurrency is handled at the Fjall layer which manages its own synchronization. Loom would be relevant for multi-threaded access to the same key, which is not the scenario being proven.

proptest for semantic validity: generates arbitrary JournalEvent bytes and verifies InvalidEvent returned for is_valid() failures. This complements Kani's formal proof with concrete test vectors. Good complementary evidence.
proptest for snapshot budget: arbitrary RunSnapshot -> encode -> decode -> verify payload_len <= MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES. Roundtrip property test. Good complement to Kani formal proof.
proptest for blob budget: arbitrary blob bytes -> encode -> decode -> verify payload_len <= MAX_BLOB_BYTES. Roundtrip property test. Good complement to Kani formal proof.
